template.name: Expert AML MFI
template.entry_long: close > open and close - open >= {p0} * atr(high,low,close,{p0}) and rsi(close,{p1}) <= {p1}
template.notes: RSI(12) at the documented 40/70/30 levels proxies MFI, while a full-size bullish candle is a simplified Meeting Lines proxy. The equal-close two-candle pattern and BodyAveragePeriod=4 body test cannot be reconstructed without shifted OHLC; no percentage stops are documented.
